description: This file defines the ViewAddForm class, a Drupal form controller for creating and managing views within the Views UI module. It handles form building, validation, submission, and AJAX interactions for adding new views.

classes.name: ViewAddForm
classes.description: A Drupal form controller class for adding new views through the Views UI, extending ViewFormBase and implementing form handling, validation, and AJAX interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wizard manager and module handler services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: prepareEntity
methods.description: Prepares the entity; overridden to do nothing during addition.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the form array for adding a new view, including view name, description, display settings, and AJAX triggers.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions such as submit and cancel buttons.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, including view-specific validation via the wizard instance.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, creating and saving the new view entity.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Handles the cancel action by redirecting to the view collection page.
